area: Keystone testbed: root motion of the shipped idle clips

find.report_claim: root_motion was one of 21 Keystone modules the testbed never imported; the shooter ships four .kanim idle clips whose subject node rotates, so their real root delta is a meaningful AI/soak report
find.live_evidence: over a 0.3 s window the four idle clips have distinct subject yaws: wisp 1.570796, mite 0.096, brute 0.052502, warden 0.03; over a full 2 s loop each closes to identity
find.consumer_evidence: extract_root_motion raises when the animated node is absent, so a wrong root name is not silently reported as a motionless clip; in_place_pose returns a copy with the root reset to identity

read: shooter/anim.py: CLIP_NAMES and the four loaded idle clips
probe of clip samples at t=0.0 (all identity) vs t=0.3 (distinct yaws)
killed: applying the extracted delta to a scene node: that would change presentation state per call and risk the hash; the report stays pure JSON
reporting full-loop deltas only: every idle loop closes to identity, so the report would look like a motionless game; the default window is 0.3 s
silently accepting a missing root node: Keystone raises, and the mutation check uses that to prove the tests see a wrong name
analyze.survivor: an on-demand idle_root_motion_report() over the shipped clips with a measured-window delta and an in-place pose proof

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py imports extract_root_motion/in_place_pose/root_motion_report and CLIP_NAMES, and adds idle_root_motion_report(window=0.3); tests/test_keystone_root_motion_mechanics.py (5 tests) pins report shape, measured yaw bands, loop closure, in-place proof and sim isolation; README testbed matrix and tree name the consumer and test

shooter.failing_first: all 5 new tests failed before the consumer existed (ShooterGame has no idle_root_motion_report)
shooter.measured: window 0.3: wisp yaw 1.570796, mite 0.096, brute 0.052502, warden 0.03, all positions zero; window 2.0: all yaws ~0 (loops close); in_place true
shooter.mutation: changing the extracted node from 'subject' to 'root' fails all 5 tests with the module's missing-node error; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 cb6c00100a082f050521d8dc0ea3b27f69a3c768eca0325197bf422357806864)
shooter.codebase_map: regenerated after the new imports, method and test module
